title: Tickets, please.
description: A dialogue lesson on 'had better' and 'must'. George and Ken buy two return tickets to London and ask about the next train, which leaves at eight nineteen from Platform Two. Thinking they have plenty of time, they go to a bar next door to the station for a drink. When they return, the porter tells them they have just missed the train — the bar's clock was ten minutes slow, and the next train is not until five hours later. New vocabulary includes return, train, platform, plenty, bar, station, porter, catch, and miss. Workbook practice covers completing the dialogue (fill in missing words) and choosing the correct word. Grammar exercises practise giving replies with 'had better', writing sentences with 'must', and rewriting 'a lot of' as 'plenty of'.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Why did George and Ken miss the train) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (complete dialogue) first 13 blanks are taken from the supplied Lesson 95 key (img/key-091-095.jpg); the remaining 13 blanks in the 'Later.' section are not printed in the key and are marked as suggested. Practice B (choose the correct word) 6 items are not printed in the key and are marked as suggested. Grammar I (had better replies) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-11 are taken from the supplied Lesson 95 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 510-511). Grammar II (must sentences) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-11 are taken from the supplied Lesson 95 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 511). Grammar III (a lot of -> plenty of) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 95 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 511).

lesson-095-scene-01.description: George and Ken at a railway station: buying tickets from the attendant, asking about the platform, having a drink in a bar next door to the station, and being stopped by the porter who tells them they have missed the train.
lesson-095-scene-01.reason: Odd lesson: text first; illustration deferred.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question. Why did George and Ken miss the train?
听录音，然后回答问题。为什么乔治和肯误了火车？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the question: Why did George and Ken miss the train?

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text:
Two return tickets to London, please.
What time will the next train leave?
lines.translation: 乔治：买两张到伦敦的往返票。下一班火车什么时候开？

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.text: What time will the next train leave?
lines.translation: 肯：下一班火车什么时候开？

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.translation: 肯：我们的时间还很充裕。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: It's only three minutes to eight.

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.text:
Let's go and have a drink.
There's a bar
next door to the station.
lines.translation: 肯：让我们去喝点东西吧，车站旁有一个酒吧。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text:
We had better
go back to the station now, Ken.
lines.translation: 乔治：肯，我们现在最好回到车站去。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text:
We want to catch
the eight nineteen to London.
lines.translation: 乔治：我们要乘8点19分的车去伦敦。

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.translation: 乘务员：你们刚好错过了那班车。

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text:
It's only eight fifteen.
I'm sorry, sir.
lines.translation: 乘务员：现在只有8点15分。对不起，先生。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text:
That clock's ten minutes slow.
When's the next train?
lines.translation: 乔治：那个钟慢了10分钟。下一班车是什么时候？

questions.prompt: Why did George and Ken miss the train?
questions.answer: They missed the train because they went to a bar next door to the station to have a drink, and the clock in the bar was ten minutes slow. By the time they went back, the train had already left.

items.title: next door to ...
items.text: next door to ..., 与……相邻，在……隔壁。

items.title: had better
items.text: had better 相当于情态动词，当"最好"讲，用于指现在和将要做的事情。各种人称后面的形式相同，简写作 'd better。后面接动词原形。

items.title: catch the eight nineteen to London
items.text: catch the eight nineteen to London, 这里的 eight nineteen 是指 8 点 19 分的火车，to London 是表示火车的行车方向。

items.title: in five hours' time
items.text: in five hours' time, 5 小时之后。这里的介词 in 是"在……之后"的意思，复数名词 hours 后面用所有格，直接加表示所有格的撇号就可以，不必再加 s。

grammar.title: I. Give correct replies to the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。(had better)
grammar.instruction:
Give correct replies to the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。

Example (item 1):
I feel tired. (you/sit down)
You'd better sit down.
grammar.translation: Write a correct reply to each sentence using 'had better', following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 11 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-11 are taken from the supplied Lesson 95 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 510-511).

questions.prompt: 1. I feel tired. (you/sit down)
2. He's thirsty. (he/have a cup of tea)
questions.answer: He'd better have a cup of tea.

questions.prompt: 3. It's hot in this room. (we/open the windows)
4. I've got a cold. (you/drink more water)
5. She's tired. (she/have a rest)
6. Your coat is dirty. (you/take off)
7. Our boss is ill. (we/go and see him tomorrow)
questions.answer: We'd better go and see him tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 8. He has got a headache. (he/take an aspirin)
9. They feel cold. (they/put on more clothes)
questions.answer: They'd better put on more clothes.

questions.prompt: 10. There is not much milk in the refrigerator. (we/buy some)
11. It's raining outside. (we/stay at home tonight)
questions.answer: We'd better stay at home tonight.

grammar.title: II. Practise "must" by writing sentences according to the example, using the cues given. 仿照例句用 must 造句。
grammar.instruction:
Practise "must" by writing sentences according to the example, using the cues given. 仿照例句用 must 造句。

Example (item 1):
He's had a bad stomachache. (go and see a doctor)
He must go and see a doctor.
grammar.translation: Write a sentence with 'must' for each item, using the cue given, following the printed example.

questions.prompt: 1. He's had a bad stomachache. (go and see a doctor)
questions.answer: He must go and see a doctor.

questions.prompt: 2. I'm very hungry. (have a meal)
3. He's sleeping now. (you/keep quiet)
4. There isn't any sugar in the jar. (I/buy some)
5. They have got measles. (we/call the doctor)
6. It's very cold outside. (you/stay at home)
7. Your hair is very long. (have a haircut)
8. Our room is very dirty. (clean it)
9. Susan has a temperature. (stay in bed)
10. Turn off the television. (do your homework)

grammar.title: III. Rewrite the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句改写下列句子。(a lot of -> plenty of)
grammar.instruction:
Rewrite the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句改写下列句子。

Example (item 1):
There are a lot of books in our new library.
There are plenty of books in our new library.
grammar.translation: Rewrite each sentence, replacing 'a lot of' with 'plenty of', following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf

questions.answer: There are plenty of books in our new library.

questions.prompt: 2. They've got a lot of money.
3. There are usually a lot of people in the park at week-ends.
questions.answer: There are usually plenty of people in the park at week-ends.

questions.prompt: 4. We can't leave now. We still have a lot of work to do.
questions.answer: We can't leave now. We still have plenty of work to do.

questions.prompt: 5. You must drink a lot of water.
questions.answer: You must drink plenty of water.

questions.prompt: 6. She must read a lot of books to pass the exam next year.
questions.answer: She must read plenty of books to pass the exam next year.

questions.prompt: 7. We still have a lot of time.
questions.answer: We still have plenty of time.

questions.prompt: 8. A lot of Korean tourists will come here next month.
questions.answer: Plenty of Korean tourists will come here next month.

questions.prompt: 9. We still have a lot of milk in the refrigerator.
questions.answer: We still have plenty of milk in the refrigerator.

questions.prompt: 10. John has got a lot of ties.
questions.answer: John has got plenty of ties.
